curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: create patterns of different sizes and shapes using real objects

mission.title: create patterns of different sizes and shapes using real objects

interactions.prompt: Look: small bottle top, big bottle top, small bottle top. What comes next?
interactions.feedback: Yes! The small and big bottle tops take turns.
interactions.retryHint: Say the pattern: small, big, small. Which one is missing?

interactions.prompt: Help the lion make this spoon pattern: small spoon, big spoon, small spoon, big spoon.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the object that comes next instead of dragging it.
interactions.feedback: Good pattern making! Small, big, small, big.
interactions.retryHint: The spoons are taking turns. After small comes big.

interactions.prompt: Put the next two bottle tops in the row: round, square, round, square, __, __.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap round, then square to fill the two spaces.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Round, square repeats again.
interactions.retryHint: Find the two shapes that repeat: round then square.

interactions.prompt: Make a size pattern with beans: small, small, big, small, small, big.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each bean in order to build the row.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You repeated small, small, big.
interactions.retryHint: Build one group first: two small beans and one big bean. Then repeat it.

interactions.prompt: At a picnic, make a mat border: circle leaf, triangle leaf, triangle leaf. Repeat it once.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the leaves in order to make the border.
interactions.feedback: Lovely! Your circle, triangle, triangle border repeats.
interactions.retryHint: Make the first group: one circle leaf and two triangle leaves. Then make it again.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Make this pattern twice: small round stone, big square stone.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the stones in order to make the pattern.
interactions.feedback: You did it! You repeated a pattern with both size and shape.
interactions.retryHint: Use the same pair again: small round stone, then big square stone.
